title: Talented Duo, J Cru comes together with Fresh micks in their recent track “Man Cake”
htmlContent:
From spinning intricate lyrical webs and sonic stories to crafting visual epics for their ever-expanding discography, LA-based music duo J Cru feeds upon their deep love for Hip Hop, unwavering ambition, and comedic chops to share their journey with all who will listen. J Cru comes together with Fresh Micks to deliver a must hear track titled “Man Cake.”

The J Cru and Fresh Micks combine all their resources to make this incredible sound. “Man Cake” is an astonishing record to display everyone’s musical brilliance, with them crafting together a song that the world will love. The singing is brilliant, the lyrics are correct, and the production brings everything together, making this song unique.
